title: Interior Room for my 2.5D Game
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey guys. Just wanted to share a quick preview of another interior room I've been working on for GodScar This is just one of many environments I'm creating for the game.

Built in Godot using Claude Opus 5.5. Let me know what you think. Any feedback or suggestions are always appreciated.

comments.author: Bavariasnaps
comments.body:
It looks like at least 3 different artstyles mixed in one game that do not work together. Also the music sounds like I turned on my radio, the female voice overshadows your whole game also breaks with the style. 

I like the generell level design and the god rays. But the room is way to small for what all you packed in. like 20m high stone figures, a small black hole, the furniture of a halve church and a halve library.

replies.author: irbrandonl
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback!

Also, just to clarify, the music was only added for the video. I haven't implemented all the sound effects yet, so the footage would've been pretty much silent otherwise. I just used one of the game's existing tracks as a temporary background song.

replies.author: Charlemagneffxiv
replies.body:
>It looks like at least 3 different artstyles mixed in one game that do not work together.

Have you played any of the HD 2.5D games? That's literally what the genre is man. You have pixel tile art, photo-realistic statues, stylish grass and water, etc. all mixed in with Unreal Lumen lighting engine and flares and other effects

Go load up Octopath Traveler or the Dragon Quest 1-3 remakes. You'll see at least four different art styles mixed together. Heck, the Dragon Quest 7 Remake even made the characters look like stopmotion clay puppets.

Also, the Cathedral in Octopath Traveler is obviously what he's modeled this location on.

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: I did not know I have to have experience with games like OT to give feedback. I dont know which specific OT game you mean but for me this all loos super consistent [https://de.ign.com/octopath-traveler-0/150500/video/octopath-traveler-0-official-gameplay-overview-trailer](https://de.ign.com/octopath-traveler-0/150500/video/octopath-traveler-0-official-gameplay-overview-trailer)

replies.author: Charlemagneffxiv
replies.body: The trailer isn't the entire game.

comments.author: Tiamitsu
comments.body: I think it's really cool, I really like the style you chose. You can tell you put a lot of work into it :-) I would push the lighting a bit further, I think it would give the environment more punch.
